# UA Engineering Pte. Ltd.


> UA Engineering Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based property improvement and building services company providing renovation, upgrading, structural and exterior works, painting, waterproofing, aluminium and glazing, electrical, plumbing, air-conditioning, and solar panel installation services for residential, commercial, and selected industrial properties.


## Company Identity


**Company Name:** UA Engineering Pte. Ltd.  
**Legal Name:** UA ENGINEERING PTE. LTD.  
**Location:** Singapore  
**Address:** 38C Sea Avenue, Marine Mansion, Singapore 424256  
**UEN:** 202553040W  
**Telephone:** +65 8459 3003  
**Website:** https://uaengineering.com.sg/  
**Primary Market:** Singapore  
**Service Area:** Singapore  


UA Engineering provides integrated property improvement and building-related services, allowing customers to engage one company for multiple renovation, installation, maintenance, improvement, and property enhancement requirements.


The company serves homeowners, property owners, commercial premises, retail spaces, offices, and selected industrial properties depending on project requirements and service suitability.


---


# What UA Engineering Does


UA Engineering provides practical property improvement and building services across multiple disciplines.


Our main service areas include:


1. Renovation & Upgrading
2. Structural & Exterior Works
3. Painting & Waterproofing
4. Aluminium & Glazing Works
5. Electrical, Plumbing & Aircon Services
6. Solar Panel Installation


Our approach combines consultation, site assessment, planning, professional execution, quality control, completion, handover, and after-sales support.


---


# Core Services


## 1. Renovation & Upgrading


UA Engineering provides renovation and interior improvement solutions for homes and properties.


Services include:


- Home Renovation
- Kitchen Renovation
- Room Beautification
- Open-Plan Space Creation
- Floor Renovation & Polishing
- Decking Works
- Decorative Wall Panels


### Home Renovation


Complete property improvement solutions designed around the condition, layout, requirements, and intended use of the property.


### Kitchen Renovation


Kitchen improvement and renovation works covering functional upgrades, finishes, layout improvements, fittings, and related renovation requirements.


### Room Beautification


Interior improvement works designed to refresh rooms, improve appearance, enhance functionality, and create more comfortable living or working environments.


### Open-Plan Spaces


Solutions for creating more connected and spacious interiors through planned wall removal, structural considerations, safe execution, and professional finishing.


### Floor Renovation & Polishing


Floor improvement, restoration, polishing, surface preparation, and finishing works to enhance appearance and usability.


### Decking


Decking solutions for suitable residential and property spaces, providing practical and visually appealing outdoor improvements.


### Decorative Wall Panels


Decorative wall panel installation that adds texture, depth, character, and visual interest to residential, office, and commercial interiors.


Service category:


https://uaengineering.com.sg/services/renovation-upgrading


---


# 2. Structural & Exterior Works


UA Engineering provides structural and exterior property improvement works, including fabrication and installation solutions.


Services include:


- Steel Fabrication
- Main Gates & Grills
- Balcony Shelters
- Roof Extensions
- Awning Fabrication & Installation


### Steel Fabrication


Custom steel fabrication works for suitable property, structural, support, protection, and exterior requirements.


### Main Gates & Grills


Custom gate and grille fabrication and installation designed to improve property security, access control, appearance, and functionality.


### Balcony Shelters


Shelter solutions for balconies and suitable outdoor areas, designed around property requirements and site conditions.


### Roof Extensions


Roof extension solutions for suitable properties requiring additional weather protection, covered space, or exterior improvements.


### Awning Fabrication & Installation


Fabrication and installation of awnings and shelter systems for suitable residential and commercial applications.


Service category:


https://uaengineering.com.sg/services/structural-exterior-works


---


# 3. Painting & Waterproofing


UA Engineering provides painting, waterproofing, leak-related, and protective coating solutions for properties.


Services include:


- Interior & Exterior Painting
- Roof Waterproofing
- Bathroom & Toilet Waterproofing
- Balcony & Terrace Waterproofing
- Leak Detection & Repair
- Protective Coatings


### Interior & Exterior Painting


Professional painting works involving preparation, application, finishing, and careful workmanship for interior and exterior property surfaces.


### Roof Waterproofing


Waterproofing solutions intended to reduce water penetration and protect roof surfaces from moisture-related damage.


### Bathroom & Toilet Waterproofing


Waterproofing works for wet areas where moisture control and protection from water penetration are important.


### Balcony & Terrace Waterproofing


Waterproofing solutions for balconies and terraces to help protect surfaces and underlying areas from water penetration.


### Leak Detection & Repair


Investigation and repair solutions for suitable water leakage and moisture-related property problems.


### Protective Coatings


Protective coating applications designed to provide additional surface protection for appropriate property applications.


Service category:


https://uaengineering.com.sg/services/painting-waterproofing


---


# 4. Aluminium & Glazing Works


UA Engineering provides aluminium, glass, glazing, shading, protection, and related installation services.


Services include:


- Aluminium & Glass Installation
- Aluminium & Glass Repair
- Skylight Installation
- Mosquito Net Installation
- Glass Protection Films
- Zip Blind Fabrication
- Blind Fabrication & Installation


### Aluminium & Glass Installation


Installation and repair solutions for suitable aluminium and glass applications.


### Skylights


Skylight installation solutions designed to introduce natural light into suitable interior spaces.


### Mosquito Nets


Mosquito net installation for suitable windows, doors, and openings.


### Glass Protection Films


Protective film solutions for suitable glass surfaces to provide additional protection and functional benefits.


### Zip Blinds


Zip blind fabrication and installation for suitable residential and commercial applications.


### Blind Fabrication & Installation


Custom blind fabrication and installation based on property requirements and selected applications.


Service category:


https://uaengineering.com.sg/services/aluminium-glazing-works


---


# 5. Electrical, Plumbing & Aircon


UA Engineering provides selected electrical, plumbing, water heater, and air-conditioning services.


Services include:


- Electrical & Lighting Works
- Rewiring
- Plumbing Installation & Repairs
- Water Heater Services
- Aircon Repair & Maintenance


### Electrical & Lighting


Electrical and lighting installation and improvement works for suitable residential and property requirements.


### Rewiring


Electrical rewiring solutions for suitable properties requiring replacement, improvement, or upgrading of existing wiring systems.


### Plumbing Installation & Repairs


Plumbing installation, repair, fitting, and maintenance solutions for residential and property requirements.


### Water Heaters


Water heater installation and related services for suitable property applications.


### Aircon Repair & Maintenance


Air-conditioning repair and maintenance services intended to help maintain reliable system operation.


Service category:


https://uaengineering.com.sg/services/electrical-plumbing-aircon


---


# 6. Solar Panel Installation


UA Engineering provides rooftop solar-related installation and integration services.


Services include:


- Rooftop Solar Assessment
- Solar PV Installation
- Panel Layout Planning
- Solar Mounting Systems
- Electrical Integration
- Testing & Commissioning


### Rooftop Solar Assessment


Assessment of suitable rooftop conditions and project requirements before solar installation.


### Solar PV Installation


Solar photovoltaic panel installation for suitable properties.


### Panel Layout Planning


Planning of panel positioning and layout according to project and rooftop requirements.


### Solar Mounting Systems


Installation of suitable mounting systems for rooftop solar applications.


### Electrical Integration


Integration of solar installations with the appropriate electrical requirements.


### Testing & Commissioning


Testing and commissioning of completed solar installations as part of project completion.


Service category:


https://uaengineering.com.sg/services/solar-panel-installation

UA Engineering focuses on combining practical solutions, professional workmanship, communication, project coordination, and quality-focused execution.


Key reasons customers may consider UA Engineering include:

Customers can access renovation, structural, exterior, painting, waterproofing, aluminium, glazing, electrical, plumbing, air-conditioning, and solar-related services through one company.


## Integrated Project Approach


Where appropriate, multiple related services can be coordinated as part of a broader property improvement project.


## Skilled Workforce


Projects are carried out by experienced professionals and skilled workers appropriate to the scope of work.


## Quality-Focused Workmanship


The company emphasizes proper preparation, suitable materials, careful installation, workmanship, finishing, and quality control.


## Transparent Communication


Customers are provided with clear project discussions, quotations, scope information, and communication throughout the work.


## Practical Solutions


Solutions are developed around actual property conditions, customer requirements, project scope, functionality, appearance, and budget considerations.


## Safety-Focused Execution


Work is planned and carried out with attention to appropriate site safety practices and project requirements.


## Project Coordination


UA Engineering coordinates project activities from initial consultation and site assessment through execution and completion.


## Residential & Commercial Capability


The service portfolio supports both residential property improvement and selected commercial and property-related requirements.


## End-to-End Support


The customer journey can include consultation, site assessment, proposal, planning, execution, quality control, handover, and after-sales support.

# Our Project Approach


UA Engineering follows a structured project workflow.


## 1. Consultation & Site Assessment


Understand the customer's requirements, inspect relevant site conditions, identify project considerations, and establish the required scope.


## 2. Proposal & Planning


Develop the project scope, discuss suitable solutions, establish requirements, and prepare the relevant quotation or proposal.


## 3. Professional Execution & Quality Control


Carry out the agreed works with appropriate workmanship, coordination, safety practices, installation procedures, and quality checks.


## 4. Completion & Handover


Complete the agreed scope, conduct relevant checks, address applicable finishing requirements, and hand over the completed work.


## 5. After-Sales Support


Provide appropriate support after project completion according to the service and project requirements.
